data_fields.name: group_attackable_switch
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: group-wide player-attackable flag or per-faction threshold set by script

best_idea: Give zone guards one standing number per faction with two bars: attack a player under the low bar (only where the zone's switch allows it), help a player at or above the high bar, and always retarget to whoever is hitting a protected player.
decision_why: Keep the two-bar standing, the group switch and the retarget-to-attacker rule; fix the dead per-bot bar override, make the bars zone data, and cap the pack at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 in the engine. The donor has no cap.
acceptance: In a zone with a guard pack, a player under the attack bar is attacked when in range; a non-guard mob hitting a player at or above the help bar draws the pack onto that mob within one tick; a player under the help bar gets no help; the pack never holds more than three targets at once.
